purpose: Frozen inputs for P9(a): certified upper bound on H0 over a stated class of late-time expansion histories.

files.content: 13 DESI DR2 BAO measurements: z, value, quantity (DV_over_rs at z=0.295; DM_over_rs and DH_over_rs at z=0.510, 0.706, 0.934, 1.321, 1.484, 2.33)
files.reference: DESI Collaboration, DESI DR2 results II, Phys. Rev. D 112, 083515 (2025), arXiv:2503.14738

1701 SN Ia light curves; columns include zHD, zHEL, m_b_corr, IS_CALIBRATOR, CEPH_DIST
files.reference: Brout et al., Astrophys. J. 938, 110 (2022), arXiv:2202.04077; Scolnic et al., Astrophys. J. 938, 113 (2022)

files.content: first line N=1701, then N*N entries row-major: statistical+systematic covariance of m_b_corr in the row order of the .dat file
files.note: not committed (33 MB); re-download and verify sha256 before use

files.content: DES-SN5YR Hubble diagram, Dovekie release (SNANA key format: VARNAMES CID IDSURVEY zHD zHEL MU MUERR MUERR_VPEC MUERR_SYS PROBIA_BEAMS; 1820 SNe, zHD in [0.025, 1.14]). m := MU (bias- and contamination-corrected distance modulus quoted for the release's fixed M_0avg = -29.96210, i.e. 'assuming H0 = 70'); the constant is absorbed by the free M' (M' ~ 25 + 5 log10 r_d)
files.reference: Popovic et al. 2025, arXiv:2506.05471 (Dovekie recalibration); DES Collaboration 2025, arXiv:2511.07517 (DES-SN reanalysis); original DES-SN5YR: DES Collaboration 2024, ApJL 973, L14, arXiv:2401.02929; Vincenzi et al. 2024, ApJ 975, 86, arXiv:2401.02945
files.release_choice: Dovekie release (repository main since 2025-11-13, commits bd96ed2/442c248) rather than the 2024 files (commit 403c761: DES-SN5YR_HD.csv + STAT+SYS.txt.gz, 1829 SNe): it is the release the maintainers currently distribute and supersedes the 2024 distances (improved cross-calibration, fixed host-color law), and its covariance is released as a single STAT+SYS precision matrix, so no assembly convention (diag(MUERR^2) + COVSYS) is needed. The 2024 files remain available at that commit if a pre-Dovekie variant is wanted

files.content: npz with keys nsn (=[1820]) and cov: the upper triangle (np.triu_indices order) of the 1820x1820 STAT+SYS *inverse* covariance of MU, in the row order of DES-Dovekie_HD.csv; unpacked exactly as in the release's DES-Dovekie-SN_Likelihood.py (data.load_dessn5yr_precision)
files.note: not committed by default (6.2 MB); re-download and verify sha256 before use

files.content: FITS primary HDU, 23x23 float64 (BITPIX -64): row 0 = the 22 bin redshifts (0.05 ... 2.26226), column 0 = the 22 binned distance moduli mu (Union3 + UNITY1.5, 'cosmo=2' spline model), the remaining 22x22 block = their inverse covariance (symmetric to 4e-11; symmetrized). The mu's carry an arbitrary additive constant (degenerate with UNITY's script-M; absorbed by M'). zHEL := zHD := z_bin. Parsed without astropy (data._read_fits_primary_image)
files.reference: Rubin et al. 2023, arXiv:2311.12098 (Union3/UNITY1.5). The repository also holds Union3.1+UNITY1.7/1.8 files (2026-04); this manifest freezes the original Union3 file
files.note: gitignored by the repository rule problems/*/data/raw/*.fits (8.6 kB); re-download and verify sha256 before use

scalar_inputs.name: r_drag_Planck2018
scalar_inputs.reference: Planck Collaboration, Planck 2018 results VI, Astron. Astrophys. 641, A6 (2020), Table 2, TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing
scalar_inputs.role: primary sound-horizon prior; box [value - 2 sigma, value + 2 sigma] in the v1 statement

scalar_inputs.name: r_drag_BBN
scalar_inputs.derivation: r_d = 147.05 Mpc (omega_b/0.02236)^-0.13 (omega_bc/0.1432)^-0.23 (N_eff/3.04)^-0.1 [DESI DR2 results II, arXiv:2503.14738, Eq. (2)] with omega_b = 0.02218 +- 0.00055 (Schoeneberg 2024, arXiv:2401.15054, PRyMordial, LCDM, PDG light-element abundances), N_eff = 3.044, omega_bc = Omega_m h^2 with Omega_m = 0.2975 +- 0.0086 (DESI DR2 BAO, LCDM) and h = 0.6851 +- 0.0058 (DESI DR2 BAO + BBN, arXiv:2503.14738 Sec. VI); sigma by linear propagation with the three inputs taken as independent (the neutrino contribution to Omega_m, ~0.5%, is neglected: 0.1% in r_d). box = value -+ 2 sigma, rounded outward to 0.01 Mpc
scalar_inputs.role: alternative sound-horizon box independent of the CMB (BBN + BAO only); select with --rd_box bbn. Since the certified bound is on u_0 = c/(r_d H0), H0_max scales exactly as 1/r_d (see report_certified)

derived.note: np.save of the 1701x1701 float64 parse (np.loadtxt) of raw/Pantheon+SH0ES_STAT+SYS.cov; checked at load time

whitening.statement: the certified statistic uses C~ := (W^T W)^{-1} with W the float64 inverse Cholesky factor of the selected covariance block; W is the recorded object
whitening.statement_precision_samples: for DES-SN5YR and Union3 the released object is the precision matrix P; W := L^T with P_sym = L L^T (Cholesky, P_sym = (P + P^T)/2), so W^T W = P_sym to rounding and C~ = (W^T W)^{-1}; no inverse is formed on the certified path (model.whitener_from_precision). SN.cov = inv(P_sym) is kept only for subsets, the LCDM fit and the diagnostic below
